t: This is the Hauer-King House, a single-family detached home in London. It was designed by Jan Kaplický, the Czech architect and designer who lived from 1937 to 2009. I don't have more to tell you about the house or about his career from the material in front of me, so I'll keep it short. It's a private home, so enjoy it from the street, and take in what a house by a modern architect looks like among its neighbours.
